sentence: This project evaluates the long-term harms and benefits of changes in prostate cancer screening and treatment.
This project makes nanoparticles that carry immune drugs to specific immune cells to help transplanted organs last longer.
This project studies how a protein tied to telomeres works in muscle stem cells and in regenerating myofibers.
This project builds microdevices that study blood processes and can serve as disease models, diagnostics and drug discovery tools.
This project tests treatments that target a cell surface protein to fight drug resistance in cartilage bone cancer.
This project builds tools to map, change and model the mechanical forces between cells in living tissues.
This project builds an imaging system and a thin probe to detect sensorineural cells in the inner ear and measure their metabolic activity.
This project studies how long-term alcohol exposure changes a neural circuit involved in inflexible alcohol drinking.
This project replaces an end-of-life MRI scanner with a research MRI system to support studies of disease and treatment options.
This project studies how retinoic acid controls genes in tenocytes and the lower jaw tissues around them.
This project adds testing capacity to analyze animal food and drug samples during large emergencies and routine surveillance.
This project uses immune system data across pregnancy and computational methods to study how the immune system changes during pregnancy.
This project builds tools to test whether CT images still show liver lesions and other subtle problems when the imaging dose is reduced.
This project tests whether neurostimulation through the skin eases withdrawal symptoms that follow naloxone treatment of opioid overdose.
This project studies how a helper protein moves a cancer-causing protein within cells and drives growth in leukemias.
This project aims to improve outcomes for cancer patients through work in genetics, genomics, translational medicine and cancer immunology.
This project uses computer methods that read text to find social and behavioral factors in veterans and study how they relate to Alzheimer’s Disease.
This project develops a preventive vaccine that makes broadly neutralizing antibodies against HIV-1.
This project studies how a rare damaging variant disrupts ovarian function and whether it causes polycystic ovary syndrome.
This project maps how suicide ideation and behaviors change in Black youth from adolescence into young adulthood and which risk and protective factors matter.
